luminance: linear Rec.709 converted from PNG sRGB

nearLeftGearScale.rationale: Bounding box around the source-defined 19.2 mm gear rim and top scale detail.

centreConcentricTarget.rationale: Bounding box around the source-defined concentric target and crosshair.

farRightFineArray.rationale: Bounding box around the source-defined 5x4 pad array and adjacent fine traces.

fixtureRail.rationale: Fixed dark rail control outside the three precision surfaces.

background.rationale: Fixed empty upper-left film area, away from the subject and guides.

caveat: Fixed feature ROIs are readability diagnostics, not physical sharpness or photographic ground truth. The station ROI gradient combines material contrast and optical blur.
